verdict.rationale: Mirrors says context changes reach the agent mid-conversation with "no redeploy, no code change." Those changes can append guidance, edit tool descriptions, tighten tool schemas, or rewrite tool-result content. Teams can preview routing against stored traces before activation and keep, revise, or roll back a change, which implies change management. Missing for 10: explicit versioning features (version history, diffs, labeled releases), in-depth docs beyond the marketing site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
